mandate.centerDescription.zh-CN: 先管理已有投资目标与约束，再按需要新增、修改或删除。已发布版本保持审计留痕，修改会生成新版本并替代原版本。
mandate.centerDescription.en-US: Manage existing investment objectives first, then add, edit or delete as needed. Published versions remain auditable; editing creates a new version that replaces the prior one.

mandate.savedObjectiveTitle.zh-CN: 已保存投资目标与约束

mandate.objectivesTable.zh-CN: 已发布投资目标与约束列表

mandate.deleteObjectiveConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除“{{name}}”？它会从可用列表移除，但历史研究审计记录仍保留。
mandate.deleteObjectiveConfirm.en-US: Delete “{{name}}”? It will be removed from the available list while its historical audit record remains.

mandate.deletedNotice.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束已从可用列表删除。
mandate.deletedNotice.en-US: The investment objective was removed from the available list.

mandate.noObjectives.zh-CN: 还没有投资目标与约束

mandate.noObjectivesHint.zh-CN: 先添加一套目标、风险等级和现金约束，保存后会出现在这里。
mandate.noObjectivesHint.en-US: Add an objective, risk level and cash constraints. Saved versions will appear here.

mandate.loadingObjectives.zh-CN: 正在读取投资目标与约束…

mandate.editingPublishedHint.zh-CN: 正在修改“{{name}}”。原版本保持只读；保存后新版本会替代它出现在主列表中。
mandate.editingPublishedHint.en-US: Editing “{{name}}”. The original remains read-only; after saving, the new version replaces it in the main list.

mandate.description.zh-CN: 先说明资金任务和成功标准，再用已确认的政策与风险标尺核验目标。系统给出建议，人确认最终授权。
mandate.description.en-US: Define the funding task and success criteria, then assess them against an explicit policy and risk scale. Confirm the authorization after reviewing the evidence.

mandate.simpleDescription.zh-CN: 只设置投资目标、最大风险等级和现金需求；系统用所选风险等级配置的参考参数计算目标是否可实现。
mandate.simpleDescription.en-US: Set only the investment objective, maximum risk level and cash needs. The system assesses feasibility using the selected risk scale's frozen reference assumptions.

mandate.pitDateLocked.zh-CN: PIT 已开启，研究日自动跟随当前 PIT，不能在本页修改。
mandate.pitDateLocked.en-US: PIT is enabled. The research date follows the active PIT date and is read-only here.

mandate.pitDateManual.zh-CN: PIT 已关闭，可手动选择研究日。
mandate.pitDateManual.en-US: PIT is off. Choose the research date manually.

mandate.pitOff.zh-CN: PIT 已关闭 · 研究日可手动选择
mandate.pitOff.en-US: PIT off · research date can be selected manually

mandate.chooseScaleFirst.zh-CN: 先在上方选择一个风险等级配置，这里会列出 C1–C5 的波动上限、参考收益和历史回撤。
mandate.chooseScaleFirst.en-US: Choose a risk-scale version above and C1–C5 will be listed here with their volatility caps, reference returns and historical drawdowns.

mandate.levelPortraitBasis.zh-CN: 卡片数值来自所选标尺冻结的参考口径，用于说明各等级大致意味着什么，不是本次组合的预测。
mandate.levelPortraitBasis.en-US: Card values come from the frozen reference basis of the chosen scale. They show roughly what each level means; they are not a forecast for this portfolio.

mandate.targetNeedsHigherLevel.zh-CN: 你的目标年收益 {{target}} 高于 C{{level}} 的参考收益 {{reference}}。参考口径下大致需要 C{{suggested}} 才能覆盖；也可以下调目标收益。诊断结果以下一步为准。
mandate.targetNeedsHigherLevel.en-US: Your {{target}} target return is above C{{level}}'s {{reference}} reference return. On the reference basis roughly C{{suggested}} would be needed; lowering the target also works. The next step gives the authoritative diagnosis.

mandate.targetAboveAllLevels.zh-CN: 你的目标年收益 {{target}} 高于该标尺所有等级的参考收益。请下调目标或换用其他风险等级配置。
mandate.targetAboveAllLevels.en-US: Your {{target}} target return is above the reference return of every level on this scale. Lower the target or use a different risk-scale version.

mandate.impactSummary.zh-CN: 本目标将约束后续研究

mandate.impactSummaryHint.zh-CN: 保存后，下列数值会被冻结并交给 SAA 与 TAA。填写过程中可以随时在这里看到它们成形。
mandate.impactSummaryHint.en-US: Once saved, the values below are frozen and handed to SAA and TAA. Watch them take shape as you fill the form.

mandate.impactVolatilityEffect.zh-CN: SAA 与 TAA 的组合预期波动一旦超过它就会被拦下。
mandate.impactVolatilityEffect.en-US: SAA and TAA reject any portfolio whose expected volatility exceeds it.

mandate.impactReturnEffect.zh-CN: SAA 只保留预期收益不低于它的候选组合。
mandate.impactReturnEffect.en-US: SAA keeps only candidate portfolios whose expected return is at least this value.

mandate.impactExcessEffect.zh-CN: SAA 会校验相对该等级代表组合的预期超额收益和跟踪误差。
mandate.impactExcessEffect.en-US: SAA checks expected excess return and tracking error against the level's representative portfolio.

mandate.impactFundingTargetEffect.zh-CN: 按现金流模拟达标概率；概率不足时候选组合不被接受。
mandate.impactFundingTargetEffect.en-US: Success probability is simulated from the cash flows; candidates that miss it are not accepted.

mandate.impactCashEffect.zh-CN: SAA 的现金角色资产权重不得低于它；股票 ETF 不算现金。
mandate.impactCashEffect.en-US: SAA cannot hold less than this in cash-role assets; an equity ETF does not count as cash.

mandate.impactExpiryEffect.zh-CN: 过期后采纳的 SAA 政策不能再用于当前应用，只能作为历史研究。
mandate.impactExpiryEffect.en-US: After this date the adopted SAA policy can no longer be applied, only kept as past research.

mandate.impactCurrencyEffect.zh-CN: 后续配置研究与现金预算必须同币种，不自动换汇。
mandate.impactCurrencyEffect.en-US: Later allocation research and the cash budget must use the same currency; no automatic FX conversion.

mandate.impactHorizonEffect.zh-CN: 决定现金流月数，后续配置研究必须沿用同一期限。
mandate.impactHorizonEffect.en-US: Sets the number of cash-flow months; later allocation research must reuse the same horizon.

mandate.reachability.zh-CN: 目标与风险上限是否匹配
mandate.reachability.en-US: Does the target fit the risk cap?

mandate.reachableUnderCap.zh-CN: 在 {{cap}} 的波动上限下，参考约束前沿最高可达年化 {{reachable}}。
mandate.reachableUnderCap.en-US: Under the {{cap}} volatility cap, the constrained reference frontier reaches at most {{reachable}} a year.

mandate.bindingVolatilityCap.zh-CN: 这低于你设定的 {{target}}，所以现在是波动上限在卡住目标。要达到 {{target}} 大约需要 {{volatility}} 的波动，即 {{level}}。请提高风险等级或下调目标收益。
mandate.bindingVolatilityCap.en-US: That is below your {{target}} target, so the volatility cap is what binds. Reaching {{target}} needs roughly {{volatility}} volatility, i.e. {{level}}. Raise the risk level or lower the target.

mandate.bindingUnreachable.zh-CN: 参考前沿上没有任何组合能达到 {{target}}，提高风险等级也不行。请下调目标收益或改用其他参考假设。
mandate.bindingUnreachable.en-US: No portfolio on the reference frontier reaches {{target}}, not even at a higher risk level. Lower the target or use different reference assumptions.

mandate.bindingNone.zh-CN: 目标 {{target}} 在当前波动上限内可达，风险上限没有卡住收益目标。
mandate.bindingNone.en-US: The {{target}} target is reachable within the current volatility cap; the risk cap is not binding.

mandate.reachabilityBasis.zh-CN: 以上基于所选标尺冻结的参考假设和本次现金约束，是研究证据，不构成本次 SAA 的采纳证明。
mandate.reachabilityBasis.en-US: Based on the frozen reference assumptions of the chosen scale plus this objective's cash constraint. Research evidence, not proof that a given SAA may be adopted.

mandate.reviewDateOptional.zh-CN: 可选。填写后，采纳的 SAA 政策到该日即失效，不能再用于当前应用；留空表示不设复核期限。
mandate.reviewDateOptional.en-US: Optional. The adopted SAA policy expires on this date and can no longer be applied; leave it blank for no review deadline.

mandate.objectiveTypeHint.zh-CN: 决定后续 SAA 用哪条门槛校验候选组合：收益下限、期末资金达标概率，或相对基准的超额收益。
mandate.objectiveTypeHint.en-US: Decides which test later SAA applies to candidate portfolios: a return floor, a terminal funding success rate, or excess return over the benchmark.

mandate.fundingGoalHint.zh-CN: 期初总资金、期末目标金额和期间投入、支付在下面「这笔钱的进出」里按发生顺序填：它们是同一笔账，服务端按同一条现金流轴求解。
mandate.fundingGoalHint.en-US: The starting capital, the terminal amount and the contributions and payments are filled under Money in and out below, in the order they happen: one ledger, solved by the server on a single cash-flow axis.

mandate.referenceBenchmarkHint.zh-CN: 基准自动取所选风险等级的代表组合，无需另选。后续 SAA 会同时校验相对它的超额收益和跟踪误差。
mandate.referenceBenchmarkHint.en-US: The benchmark is the representative portfolio of the selected risk level; no separate benchmark is needed. Later SAA checks both excess return and tracking error against it.

mandate.cashRequiredForFunding.zh-CN: 期末与期间目标需要本金和现金流计划
mandate.cashRequiredForFunding.en-US: Payments and terminal goals require a capital and cash-flow plan

mandate.cashOptionalSimple.zh-CN: 没有期间投入或支付时可不填写本金；最低现金占比仍可单独设置。
mandate.cashOptionalSimple.en-US: If there are no contributions or payments, capital can be omitted. A minimum cash weight can still be set separately.

mandate.capitalHint.zh-CN: 决定可投本金：扣除组合外储备后进入资金模拟，并换算成组合所需现金占比。
mandate.capitalHint.en-US: Sets the investable capital: after the outside reserve it drives the funding simulation and the portfolio's required cash weight.

mandate.cashModelConvention.zh-CN: 金额按名义口径计算；额外费用和通胀默认不另加，模型约定会随结果冻结。
mandate.cashModelConvention.en-US: Amounts use nominal terms; no extra fee or inflation is added by default. Model conventions are frozen with the result.

mandate.cashflowSimpleHint.zh-CN: 只填写真实投入和必要支付；现金底线由系统自动推导。
mandate.cashflowSimpleHint.en-US: Enter only real contributions and required payments. The cash floor is derived automatically.

mandate.studyScaleHint.zh-CN: 只显示研究日当时可用的已发布版本。选定后版本被冻结，本目标的计价币种和 C1–C5 波动上限都由它决定。
mandate.studyScaleHint.en-US: Only versions published and usable on the research date are listed. The chosen version is frozen; it fixes this objective's currency and its C1–C5 volatility caps.

mandate.derivedCurrencyHint.zh-CN: 由风险等级配置带入，本页不重复设置。后续配置研究与现金预算必须同币种，不自动换汇。
mandate.derivedCurrencyHint.en-US: Inherited from the risk scale and not set again here. Later allocation research and the cash budget must use the same currency; there is no automatic FX conversion.

mandate.loadingStudyScales.zh-CN: 正在读取该研究日可用的风险等级配置…
mandate.loadingStudyScales.en-US: Loading risk scales available on this research date…

mandate.noStudyScales.zh-CN: 这个研究日没有可用的风险等级配置
mandate.noStudyScales.en-US: No risk scale is available on this research date

mandate.noStudyScalesHint.zh-CN: 请先在风险等级配置中心发布适用于该日期的版本，或在 PIT 关闭时调整研究日。
mandate.noStudyScalesHint.en-US: Publish a version applicable to this date in Risk Scale Settings, or change the research date when PIT is off.

mandate.maxRiskLevelHint.zh-CN: 选定后冻结成一个数值波动上限（例如 C3 即该标尺的 C3 上限）。后续 SAA 与 TAA 的组合预期波动一旦超过它就会被拦下。
mandate.maxRiskLevelHint.en-US: The chosen level is frozen into a numeric volatility cap (C3 means the scale's C3 cap). Later SAA and TAA reject any portfolio whose expected volatility exceeds it.

mandate.minCashWeightHint.zh-CN: 与机构要求、现金流推导底线取最严的一个，成为后续 SAA 必须满足的现金下限；只认现金角色资产，股票 ETF 不算。
mandate.minCashWeightHint.en-US: The strictest of this value, any institutional requirement and the cash-flow-derived floor becomes the cash minimum later SAA must satisfy. Only cash-role assets count; an equity ETF does not.

mandate.riskLevelResolved.zh-CN: {{level}} 对应的冻结预期波动上限为 {{cap}}。
mandate.riskLevelResolved.en-US: {{level}} has a frozen expected-volatility cap of {{cap}}.

mandate.fixedBandsHint.zh-CN: C1–C5 始终来自所选风险等级配置。现金约束会改变有效前沿，但不会重新定义风险等级。
mandate.fixedBandsHint.en-US: C1–C5 always come from the selected risk scale. Cash constraints can change the frontier but never redefine the risk bands.

mandate.pitChanged.zh-CN: 研究口径已变化；目标研究日已同步，请重新选择该日期可用的风险等级配置。
mandate.pitChanged.en-US: The research context changed. The objective date was synchronized; choose a risk scale available on that date.

mandate.simpleDiagnosisHint.zh-CN: 系统将使用风险等级配置冻结的 Reference CMA，同时计算原参考前沿和加入当前现金约束后的新前沿。
mandate.simpleDiagnosisHint.en-US: The system uses the risk scale's frozen Reference CMA to compare its original frontier with a new frontier under the current cash constraint.

mandate.fundingDetails.zh-CN: 查看现金流与资金测算明细

mandate.diagnosisEmptySimple.zh-CN: 完成前两步后，点击“运行诊断”查看两条有效前沿和最低所需风险等级。
mandate.diagnosisEmptySimple.en-US: Complete the first two steps, then run the assessment to see both frontiers and the minimum required risk level.

mandate.currentSummaryHint.zh-CN: 本模块只冻结目标、风险等级和现金约束；正式 CMA 与 SAA 在后续步骤完成。
mandate.currentSummaryHint.en-US: This module freezes only the objective, risk level and cash constraints. Formal CMA and SAA are completed later.

mandate.referenceScopeSimple.zh-CN: 结果只使用所选风险等级配置冻结的参考大类和 Reference CMA；正式 CMA 后续会重新形成新的有效前沿。
mandate.referenceScopeSimple.en-US: This result uses only the selected risk scale's frozen reference asset classes and Reference CMA. A later formal CMA will produce a new frontier.

mandate.cashConstraintRule.zh-CN: 最终现金底线取主动要求与现金流推导值的较高者，只由风险标尺中的现金类承担。
mandate.cashConstraintRule.en-US: The effective floor is the higher of the requested reserve and the cash-flow-derived floor, and only the risk scale's cash asset can satisfy it.

mandate.twoFrontiers.zh-CN: 参考前沿与当前约束前沿

mandate.frontierChartDescription.zh-CN: 风险等级配置参考有效前沿与加入当前现金约束后的有效前沿对比，横轴为预期波动，纵轴为预期收益。
mandate.frontierChartDescription.en-US: Comparison of the risk scale reference efficient frontier and the frontier after current cash constraints, with expected volatility on the x-axis and expected return on the y-axis.

mandate.referenceLineMeaning.zh-CN: 虚线：风险等级配置发布时的原始参考前沿
mandate.referenceLineMeaning.en-US: Dashed: original frontier published with the risk scale

mandate.constrainedLineMeaning.zh-CN: 实线：同一 Reference CMA 加入当前现金约束后的新前沿
mandate.constrainedLineMeaning.en-US: Solid: new frontier under current cash constraints using the same Reference CMA

mandate.frontierUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前输入无法形成两条可验证前沿，请查看上方问题后调整。
mandate.frontierUnavailable.en-US: The current inputs cannot produce two verified frontiers. Review the issues above and adjust the inputs.

mandate.currencyHint.zh-CN: 预算、CMA和风险标尺须同币种，不自动换汇。
mandate.currencyHint.en-US: Budget, CMA and risk scale must use the same currency. No automatic FX conversion.

mandate.horizonHint.zh-CN: 决定现金流的模型月数（期限×12）；后续配置研究必须沿用同一期限。1至30年整数，不自动舍入。
mandate.horizonHint.en-US: Sets the cash-flow horizon in model months (years × 12). Later allocation research must reuse the same horizon. Whole years, 1–30, never rounded.

mandate.useCashBudget.zh-CN: 这笔资金有明确本金、投入或支付计划
mandate.useCashBudget.en-US: This mandate has a capital balance, contributions or payment schedule

mandate.cashOptional.zh-CN: 现金预算可选。资金目标必须提供；绝对收益和相对基准目标也可以使用。
mandate.cashOptional.en-US: A cash budget is required for a funding goal and optional for absolute or benchmark-relative objectives.

mandate.cashScope.zh-CN: 只填写本组合的资金。组合外储备不参与本组合收益或支付；切换成功标准不会删除预算。
mandate.cashScope.en-US: Enter this portfolio’s funding only. External reserves do not earn returns or fund its payments. Changing the objective preserves this budget.

mandate.cashAdvancedHint.zh-CN: 默认保持名义金额、无额外费用即可；只有存在组合外储备、实值金额或额外费用时才需要展开调整。
mandate.cashAdvancedHint.en-US: Keep the defaults for nominal amounts and no extra fee. Expand this only for external reserves, real-value amounts, or additional fees.

mandate.outsideReserveHint.zh-CN: 只从总资金扣除一次；组合内现金保障另行计算。
mandate.outsideReserveHint.en-US: Deducted once from total capital. In-portfolio cash protection is calculated separately.

mandate.basisHint.zh-CN: 「按研究日购买力」＝先按年通胀折算成未来名义金额再进模型：期末金额乘 (1+通胀)^年数，现金流各自按发生月折算；「未来名义金额」＝按填写值直接使用。年通胀为0时两者算出来完全一样。
mandate.basisHint.en-US: Research-date purchasing power means the amount is inflated to future nominal money before the model sees it: the terminal amount by (1+π)^years, each flow by its own month. Future nominal uses the number as typed. With zero inflation the two give identical results.

mandate.inflationHint.zh-CN: 只对按购买力填写的现金流或期末目标换算，名义金额不重复加通胀。
mandate.inflationHint.en-US: Applied only to amounts entered in purchasing-power terms. Nominal amounts are not inflated again.

mandate.inflationActive.zh-CN: 按这个通胀，{{years}}年的折算倍数为 {{factor}}：按购买力填写的金额乘上它之后才进模型。
mandate.inflationActive.en-US: At this inflation the {{years}}-year conversion factor is {{factor}}: purchasing-power amounts are multiplied by it before the model sees them.

mandate.feeHint.zh-CN: 0表示未另计费用；净值中已扣除的费用不要重复填写。
mandate.feeHint.en-US: Zero means no additional fee. Do not duplicate fees already embedded in NAV.

mandate.cashflowTiming.zh-CN: 按等长模型月计算：先收益与费用，再月末投入，最后必要支付。同月不模拟逐日结算顺序。
mandate.cashflowTiming.en-US: Equal model months: returns and fees, then month-end contributions and required payments. Intramonth settlement is not modeled.

mandate.noFlows.zh-CN: 暂无期间现金流；可以仅按本金和期末目标测算。
mandate.noFlows.en-US: No intermediate cash flows. A capital balance and terminal goal can still be assessed.

mandate.returnRaisedByCashflow.zh-CN: 现金流要求的年化收益 {{required}} 高于你填的 {{stated}}，后续按 {{required}} 作为收益下限。
mandate.returnRaisedByCashflow.en-US: The cash flows require {{required}} a year, above the {{stated}} you entered; {{required}} becomes the return floor from here.

mandate.cashflowReturnCovered.zh-CN: 现金流要求的年化收益为 {{required}}，不高于你填的预期收益，收益下限按你填的数值。
mandate.cashflowReturnCovered.en-US: The cash flows require {{required}} a year, at or below the return you entered, so your number stays the floor.

mandate.cashflowReturnUnreachable.zh-CN: 现金流的支付要求在 500% 年化以内无解，请调整资金、支付计划或投资期限。
mandate.cashflowReturnUnreachable.en-US: No annual return up to 500% funds these payments; adjust the capital, the payments or the horizon.

mandate.cashflowReturnBasis.zh-CN: 口径：现金流要求的是扣费前固定年复合收益，与填写的算术预期收益口径不同；取大者是确定性下限筛选，不替代资金成功概率诊断。
mandate.cashflowReturnBasis.en-US: Basis: the cash-flow requirement is a fixed annual compound return gross of model fee, not the arithmetic expected return you entered. Taking the larger is a deterministic screen, not a funding success probability.

mandate.returnCheckPending.zh-CN: 把上面的目标和资金填完整，这里会给出这套配置真正需要的年收益，并判断所选风险等级够不够。
mandate.returnCheckPending.en-US: Finish the objective and the money above and this states the annual return the configuration actually needs, then checks the chosen level against it.

mandate.returnCheckNotApplicable.zh-CN: 相对基准目标不设算术收益下限：成功口径是相对基准的超额收益，由后续诊断给出。
mandate.returnCheckNotApplicable.en-US: A relative objective carries no arithmetic return floor: its success is the excess over the benchmark, resolved by the diagnosis.

mandate.returnCheckNeedsLevel.zh-CN: 还没选风险等级：先在上面选一个 C1–C5，才能判断够不够。
mandate.returnCheckNeedsLevel.en-US: No risk level chosen yet: pick C1–C5 above before this can say whether it is enough.

mandate.requiredReturnFromTarget.zh-CN: 按填写的目标，需要年收益 {{required}}。
mandate.requiredReturnFromTarget.en-US: The stated objective needs {{required}} a year.

mandate.requiredReturnFromCashflow.zh-CN: 按期初总资金、期间投入支付和期末金额推算，这笔钱需要扣费前年复合收益 {{required}}。
mandate.requiredReturnFromCashflow.en-US: Against the opening capital, the flows and the end balance, this money needs {{required}} a year compounded, gross of model fee.

mandate.levelReachesRequired.zh-CN: 所选 C{{level}} 的参考组合收益 {{reference}}，达到这个要求。
mandate.levelReachesRequired.en-US: The chosen C{{level}} reference portfolio returns {{reference}}, which reaches it.

mandate.lastMonthHint.zh-CN: 由开始月与频率自动推导：按频率支付到投资期限内的最后一次。
mandate.lastMonthHint.en-US: Derived from the first month and frequency: payments run to the last one inside the horizon.

mandate.terminalTargetHint.zh-CN: 这是本目标的成功条件：期末余额达到它的概率须跨过门槛。和左边的总资金、下面的现金流是同一笔账。
mandate.terminalTargetHint.en-US: This is the objective's success condition: the probability of ending at or above it must clear the threshold. Same ledger as the capital beside it and the flows below.

mandate.fundingBridge.zh-CN: 可投资本金 {{capital}} ＋ 期间投入 {{contributions}} － 必要支付 {{withdrawals}} ＝ {{net}}；期末目标 {{target}}。
mandate.fundingBridge.en-US: Investable capital {{capital}} + contributions {{contributions}} − payments {{withdrawals}} = {{net}}; terminal amount {{target}}.

mandate.fundingBridgeGap.zh-CN: 缺口 {{gap}} 必须由投资收益补上。
mandate.fundingBridgeGap.en-US: The {{gap}} gap has to come from investment return.

mandate.fundingBridgeCovered.zh-CN: 现金本身已覆盖期末金额，收益要求来自支付时点而非总额。
mandate.fundingBridgeCovered.en-US: Cash alone already covers the terminal amount; the return requirement comes from payment timing, not the total.

mandate.returnBasisHint.zh-CN: 两种写法是同一个目标，换算按几何复利。
mandate.returnBasisHint.en-US: Two ways to state one target, converted by geometric compounding.

mandate.returnConversion.zh-CN: 年化 {{annual}} ＝ {{years}} 年总收益 {{total}}。存入目标的是年化值；后续把它当算术年化收益下限使用，与几何口径不同。
mandate.returnConversion.en-US: {{annual}} a year = {{total}} over {{years}} years. The annual figure is what gets stored, and it is used downstream as an arithmetic return floor, which is a different basis from the geometric conversion.

mandate.statedBenchmark.zh-CN: 合同业绩比较基准（原文）

mandate.statedBenchmarkHint.zh-CN: 按合同或 IPS 原样记录，例如「沪深300×60%＋中债综合财富×40%」。只做留痕，不参与计算。
mandate.statedBenchmarkHint.en-US: Record it exactly as the contract or IPS states it, e.g. CSI 300 x 60% + ChinaBond Aggregate x 40%. It is kept as evidence and never enters the calculation.

mandate.statedBenchmarkProxy.zh-CN: 系统按上面的大类权重为这个基准建模：超额收益和跟踪误差都在大类轴上计算，与逐指数口径存在基差。
mandate.statedBenchmarkProxy.en-US: The system models that benchmark with the asset-class weights above: excess return and tracking error are both computed on the class axis, which carries basis risk against the index-by-index reading.

mandate.benchmarkSourceHint.zh-CN: 超额收益和主动风险都相对这个组合计算。权重落在所选风险标尺的大类资产轴上。
mandate.benchmarkSourceHint.en-US: Excess return and active risk are both measured against this portfolio. Weights sit on the asset axis of the selected risk scale.

mandate.benchmarkFromScale.zh-CN: 用所选风险等级的参考组合
mandate.benchmarkFromScale.en-US: Use the reference portfolio of the chosen risk level

mandate.benchmarkCashBasis.zh-CN: 现金资产 · 参考利率 {{rate}}

mandate.benchmarkWeightTotal.en-US: Weights total {{total}}; they must come to 100%.

mandate.terminalFloorHint.zh-CN: 留空＝只保障必要支付，收益按账户可归零推算。填了它，现金流要求的收益按这个期末余额重算，并启用资金成功概率诊断。它是底线，不是目标；若期末金额本身就是你的目标，请把目标类型改成「期末金额与期间支付」。
mandate.terminalFloorHint.en-US: Leave it empty and the plan only has to cover the payments, so the required return assumes the account may end at zero. Fill it in and the cash-flow required return is solved against this balance, and the funding probability diagnosis switches on. It is a floor, not a goal: if the terminal amount is your goal, switch the objective type to Payments and terminal balance.

mandate.successQuestion.zh-CN: 这笔资金以什么为成功标准？
mandate.successQuestion.en-US: What defines success for this mandate?

mandate.returnHint.zh-CN: 后续 SAA 只保留预期收益不低于此值的候选，低于它的组合会被直接拦下。年度算术总收益，不是保底、CAGR或业绩承诺。
mandate.returnHint.en-US: Later SAA keeps only candidates whose expected return is at least this value; anything below is rejected. Annual arithmetic total return, not a guarantee or CAGR.

mandate.fundingSuccess.zh-CN: 所有必要支付均完成，而且期末仍达到约定余额，才算成功。所需复合收益不直接作为CMA算术收益门槛。
mandate.fundingSuccess.en-US: Success requires every necessary payment and the terminal balance. Required compound growth is not substituted for the CMA arithmetic return.

mandate.completeCashFirst.zh-CN: 请返回“资金任务”补齐本金与预算；已填写的成功标准会保留。
mandate.completeCashFirst.en-US: Return to Funding task to complete the capital and budget. These criteria will be retained.

mandate.probabilityHint.zh-CN: 来自明确政策。判断使用模拟区间下界，区间不包含模型误差。
mandate.probabilityHint.en-US: An explicit policy threshold. Assessment uses the simulation interval’s lower bound, which does not cover model error.

mandate.excessReturn.zh-CN: 目标年超额收益（百分点）

mandate.benchmarkTe.zh-CN: 相对基准主动风险上限（%）

mandate.benchmarkTeHint.zh-CN: 这是相对本页基准的风险预算，不是TAA相对SAA的偏离预算。
mandate.benchmarkTeHint.en-US: Risk relative to this benchmark, not TAA deviation from SAA.

mandate.noBenchmarkScope.zh-CN: 尚无可用大类方案，须先构建真实大类后定义可计算基准。
mandate.noBenchmarkScope.en-US: Create an actual asset universe before defining a computable benchmark.

mandate.cashProtectionHint.zh-CN: 收益目标之外，另行核验必要支付；没有金额目标时不编造期末余额。
mandate.cashProtectionHint.en-US: Check payment protection separately from the return objective. Do not invent a terminal target.

mandate.noProtection.zh-CN: 仅资金算账，不定义资金成功率
mandate.noProtection.en-US: Budget arithmetic only; no cash success probability

mandate.paymentsAndFloor.zh-CN: 完成支付并保护期末余额
mandate.paymentsAndFloor.en-US: Payments plus a protected terminal balance

mandate.liquidFloorHint.zh-CN: 这是可变现资产预算；资金保障另用现金角色资产检查，不把股票ETF当作经营现金。
mandate.liquidFloorHint.en-US: A tradable-asset budget. Cash protection separately requires cash-role assets; equity ETFs are not operating cash.

mandate.illiquidCap.zh-CN: 最高非流动性资产占比（%）

mandate.taaTeHint.zh-CN: 0表示只保持SAA；此授权独立于绝对波动上限，不自动推导剩余风险预算。
mandate.taaTeHint.en-US: Zero permits no tactical tilt. This authorization is independent of the absolute volatility cap.

mandate.contributionStress.zh-CN: 压力下可收到的投入比例（%）

mandate.stressHint.zh-CN: 这是压力假设，不是情景发生概率。请依据政策明确填写。
mandate.stressHint.en-US: A stress assumption, not a scenario probability. Enter it from the stated policy.

mandate.boundaryReason.zh-CN: 风险与流动性边界的依据

mandate.preferences.zh-CN: 效用偏好、预警与复核规则
mandate.preferences.en-US: Utility preferences, alerts and review rules

mandate.aversionHint.zh-CN: 仅为效用候选参数，不是风险测评，也不定义C1–C5。
mandate.aversionHint.en-US: A utility-model parameter, not a risk profile or the definition of C1–C5.

mandate.rebalanceNote.zh-CN: 再平衡触发与恢复规则

mandate.riskMode.zh-CN: 怎样确定本次风险上限？
mandate.riskMode.en-US: How should this risk cap be determined?

mandate.riskModeHint.zh-CN: 模型给出参考建议，最高授权始终由人明确确认。
mandate.riskModeHint.en-US: The model offers reference evidence. The maximum authorization must be explicitly confirmed.

mandate.explicitNumeric.zh-CN: 使用有依据的数值授权（高级）

mandate.suggestionNeedsBudget.zh-CN: 资金建议需要先填写现金预算和非空的资金成功条件。
mandate.suggestionNeedsBudget.en-US: A funding recommendation requires a cash budget and a nonempty success condition.

mandate.scaleFreezeHint.zh-CN: 明确选择后冻结版本；全局默认变化不会改写本目标。
mandate.scaleFreezeHint.en-US: The selected version is frozen. Later default changes do not rewrite this mandate.

mandate.referencePending.zh-CN: 暂不引用，保存为参考待补充
mandate.referencePending.en-US: No reference yet; save as pending

mandate.noScales.zh-CN: 没有同币种、同风险口径的已发布标尺。可以先保存输入，不会自动填入风险上限。
mandate.noScales.en-US: No published scale matches this currency and basis. Inputs can be saved without inventing a risk cap.

mandate.openRiskCenter.zh-CN: 前往风险等级配置中心

mandate.chooseDefault.zh-CN: 明确选择当前默认标尺

mandate.authorizationHint.zh-CN: 来自明确授权，不由现金流或模型自动决定。
mandate.authorizationHint.en-US: From explicit authorization, not automatically inferred from cash flows or a model.

mandate.capNotFloor.zh-CN: C3表示不超过C3上限；实际组合可以是C1或C2，不要求主动增加风险。
mandate.capNotFloor.en-US: C3 is an upper limit. An actual C1 or C2 portfolio is permitted; taking more risk is not required.

mandate.portraitNotGuarantee.zh-CN: 参考收益与历史回撤只描述代表组合，不是同档所有组合的保证。
mandate.portraitNotGuarantee.en-US: Reference returns and drawdowns describe representative portfolios, not every portfolio in the band.

mandate.scaleCurrentBlocked.zh-CN: 该版本目前需要复核或已失效；历史结果仍可读取，新研究由服务端核验适用日期。
mandate.scaleCurrentBlocked.en-US: This version requires review or is no longer current. Historical evidence remains readable; the server checks research-date eligibility.

mandate.scaleLoadFailed.zh-CN: 风险标尺读取失败，请重试；不会用默认值补齐。
mandate.scaleLoadFailed.en-US: Risk scale loading failed. Retry; no substitute values will be used.

mandate.policyHint.zh-CN: 记录已明确的政策及来源，不使用隐藏的成功概率或现金窗口默认值。这里只确认研究政策，不代替外部审批。
mandate.policyHint.en-US: Record the explicit policy and its source. No hidden probability or cash-window defaults are used. This is not external approval.

mandate.cashRoleHint.zh-CN: 最终取此值、机构现金要求和资金推导底线的更严值；只认现金角色资产。
mandate.cashRoleHint.en-US: The effective floor is the stricter of this value, institutional requirements and funding needs. Only cash-role assets qualify.

mandate.confirmPolicy.zh-CN: 我已核对政策来源和参数；这些数值是明确要求，不是模型自动推断。
mandate.confirmPolicy.en-US: I have checked the policy source and parameters. These are explicit requirements, not model-inferred preferences.

mandate.referenceDiagnosis.zh-CN: 全局参考诊断与风险建议
mandate.referenceDiagnosis.en-US: Global reference assessment and risk recommendation

mandate.referenceScopeHint.zh-CN: 此处使用冻结全局参考。实际资产和CMA形成后，SAA仍须重新核验，不能继承此成功率。
mandate.referenceScopeHint.en-US: This uses the frozen global reference. SAA must recheck the actual assets and CMA; this success rate is not inherited.

mandate.capitalAdjustment.zh-CN: 查看固定候选下的本金调整
mandate.capitalAdjustment.en-US: Inspect capital adjustment for this fixed candidate

mandate.capitalAdjustmentHint.zh-CN: 金额已按同一路径、同一门槛回灌核验。改变本金后需建立新研究，重新计算现金预算和候选，不自动修改原目标。
mandate.capitalAdjustmentHint.en-US: Amounts are replay-checked on the same paths and gate. Changing capital requires a new study and new cash/candidate checks; the mandate is not edited automatically.

mandate.capitalDiagnosticOnly.zh-CN: 这只是已授权范围内一个固定候选的调整测算，不是通过验证的配置建议；原目标和风险授权未改变。
mandate.capitalDiagnosticOnly.en-US: This is an adjustment estimate for one fixed, authorized candidate, not a validated allocation recommendation. The original goal and authorization are unchanged.

mandate.capitalUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前路径数不足以支持该门槛的资本估计，不提供虚假金额。
mandate.capitalUnavailable.en-US: The current path count cannot support a capital estimate at this gate. No artificial amount is shown.

mandate.searchValidationEvidence.zh-CN: 搜索种子 {{search}}；独立验证种子 {{validation}}；每组 {{paths}} 条路径。验证失败不重选候选。
mandate.searchValidationEvidence.en-US: Search seed {{search}}; independent-validation seed {{validation}}; {{paths}} paths per stream. Failed validation does not trigger reselection.

mandate.clockUnknown.zh-CN: 平台知识截止日尚未确认，请先恢复 PIT 设置；草稿保留，暂不能诊断或保存。
mandate.clockUnknown.en-US: The research cutoff is unknown. Restore PIT settings before assessment or confirmation. Your draft is retained.

mandate.cmaMismatch.zh-CN: 已选CMA不在当前日期、币种、期限及大类范围内，请重新选择或明确取消。
mandate.cmaMismatch.en-US: The CMA does not match the date, currency, horizon or universe. Reselect or explicitly remove it.

mandate.savedClockChanged.zh-CN: 知识截止日已变化；当前只读版本仍显示保存时的诊断，不代表新截止日下可用。复制为新研究后须重新核对。
mandate.savedClockChanged.en-US: The cutoff changed. The read-only version retains its original assessment, not current eligibility. Copy it into a new study to reassess.

mandate.clockChanged.zh-CN: 知识截止日已变化，请重新核对输入并运行诊断。
mandate.clockChanged.en-US: The cutoff changed. Review the inputs and run a new assessment.

mandate.inputChanged.zh-CN: 输入已更新，请重新运行诊断。
mandate.inputChanged.en-US: Inputs changed. Run the assessment again.

mandate.savedNotice.zh-CN: 已保存不可变目标版本；授权来源、诊断状态和模型依据一并保留。
mandate.savedNotice.en-US: An immutable mandate version was saved with authorization sources, assessment status and model evidence.

mandate.readingSaved.zh-CN: 正在查看已保存版本，输入只读；复制为新研究后才能修改。
mandate.readingSaved.en-US: Viewing a saved, read-only version. Copy it into a new study to edit.

mandate.copiedNotice.zh-CN: 已复制输入，原版本未改变；请核对研究日期后重新诊断。
mandate.copiedNotice.en-US: Inputs copied; the original version is unchanged. Check the date and reassess.

mandate.openSaa.zh-CN: 使用此目标进入长期配置 →

mandate.institutionContext.zh-CN: 机构背景与人工核验（可选）

mandate.assetAuthorizations.zh-CN: 指定资产与分组授权（高级）

mandate.diagnosisHint.zh-CN: 先按冻结风险标尺做全局参考诊断。有匹配的实际CMA时，也可在下方选择；两类结果不会混为一种证明。
mandate.diagnosisHint.en-US: Assess the frozen global reference first. An available actual CMA can also be selected below; the two evidence scopes remain separate.

mandate.actualCma.zh-CN: 另选实际CMA进行诊断（可选）
mandate.actualCma.en-US: Assess an actual CMA as well (optional)

mandate.cmaHint.zh-CN: 只列出匹配日期、币种、期限和范围的版本，不使用未来假设。
mandate.cmaHint.en-US: Only matching dates, currencies, horizons and universes are listed. Future assumptions are excluded.

mandate.noMatchingCma.zh-CN: 暂无匹配CMA。可使用全局参考，或先保存输入后建立长期假设，不会用示例数据补成功概率。
mandate.noMatchingCma.en-US: No matching CMA. Use the global reference, or save inputs and build assumptions later. No example probabilities are substituted.

mandate.simulationSettings.zh-CN: 模拟与不确定性设置（高级）

mandate.uncertaintyPenalty.zh-CN: 均值不确定性惩罚倍数

mandate.computingHint.zh-CN: 正在按当前输入计算；尚无完成结果，不显示预测数值。
mandate.computingHint.en-US: Calculating from the current inputs. No estimated results are shown before completion.

mandate.diagnosisEmpty.zh-CN: 运行后在这里查看资金要求、约束冲突和风险建议。
mandate.diagnosisEmpty.en-US: Run the assessment to see funding needs, constraint conflicts and risk recommendations.

mandate.confirmationTitle.zh-CN: 确认的是目标与边界，不是收益承诺
mandate.confirmationTitle.en-US: Confirm objectives and boundaries, not a return promise

mandate.pendingAuthorization.zh-CN: 风险授权待补齐，不可进入SAA采纳
mandate.pendingAuthorization.en-US: Risk authorization pending; SAA adoption is unavailable

mandate.reviewOnly.zh-CN: 这里只记录政策与复核约定，不自动交易，不代替外部审批。
mandate.reviewOnly.en-US: This records policy and review terms only. It neither trades automatically nor replaces external approval.

mandate.saveIsNotPass.zh-CN: 此次保存仅固定输入和当前诊断状态。SAA仍须实际计算并满足目标，不能凭已保存绕过检查。
mandate.saveIsNotPass.en-US: Saving freezes inputs and the current assessment status. SAA must still meet its actual checks; a saved record is not a pass.

mandate.historicalReviewDue.zh-CN: 这是已过复核日的历史目标，可以保存研究，但不能直接用于当前应用。
mandate.historicalReviewDue.en-US: This historical mandate is past its review date. It can be saved for research, not applied directly today.

mandate.finalAcknowledgement.zh-CN: 我已核对输入、最终授权上限、诊断状态和模型限制；此确认不是外部审批或收益保证。
mandate.finalAcknowledgement.en-US: I have checked the inputs, final cap, assessment status and model limitations. This is not external approval or a return guarantee.

mandate.acknowledgementHint.zh-CN: 核对后勾选确认，服务端将重新计算并检查输入是否变化。
mandate.acknowledgementHint.en-US: Acknowledge after reviewing. The server recalculates and checks for changed inputs.

mandate.journeyHint.zh-CN: 资金任务 → 成功标准 → 风险预算 → 诊断 → 确认。已有成果可以直接选择，旧版本保持只读。
mandate.journeyHint.en-US: Funding → success criteria → risk budgets → assessment → confirmation. Reuse existing results; saved versions remain read-only.

mandate.noVersions.zh-CN: 尚无版本；完成诊断后可保存输入和结果。
mandate.noVersions.en-US: No saved versions. Assess the inputs before confirming a version.

mandate.catalogUnavailable.zh-CN: 目录不可用时仍可填写目标；读取失败不代表不存在历史版本。
mandate.catalogUnavailable.en-US: You can keep editing while the catalog is unavailable. A loading error does not mean no historical versions exist.

mandate.cashRollRequired.zh-CN: 现金预算仍以 {{from}} 为基准，当前研究日为 {{to}}。请核对并更新本金、储备和未来现金流；确认后，现金流月份才改以新研究日起算。确认前不能诊断或保存。
mandate.cashRollRequired.en-US: The cash budget is still dated {{from}}, while the research date is {{to}}. Review and update capital, reserves and future cash flows. Confirmation rebases the flow months to the new research date. Diagnosis and saving remain blocked until confirmed.

mandate.confirmCashRoll.zh-CN: 我已核对资金和现金流，确认按新研究日使用
mandate.confirmCashRoll.en-US: I reviewed capital and cash flows; use the new research date

landing.workflowNote.en-US: Research is ongoing. Outcomes feed back into models; portfolio registration and accounting support execution and review.

landing.coreDescription.en-US: Less time managing tools. More time exploring ideas.

landing.quoteLine2.zh-CN: 始于经得起验证的研究。

landing.footerStatus.zh-CN: 研究示例非投资建议 · 不提供下单

landing.historyHelp.zh-CN: 访问模块后，返回首页可从这里继续。
landing.historyHelp.en-US: Visit a module, then return here to continue.

landing.storageFailed.zh-CN: 无法清除浏览器访问记录，请检查浏览器存储设置。
landing.storageFailed.en-US: Could not clear visits. Check browser storage settings.

landing.aboutBody.zh-CN: 产品研究持续沉淀可复用的产品池；投前形成研究方案；真实组合承接投中与投后；数据、指标和情景算法提供共同的研究基础。
landing.aboutBody.en-US: Product research builds reusable product pools. Allocation research produces proposals. Registered portfolios connect execution with review, supported by data, indicators and scenario algorithms.

landing.aboutNote.zh-CN: 本页入口连接现有业务模块。各模块以其实际能力和数据状态为准；不提供自动下单，也不承诺投资收益。
landing.aboutNote.en-US: Links open existing workspaces. Capabilities and data availability are stated within each module. No automatic orders or promised investment returns.

landing.helpBody.zh-CN: 点击流程卡或精选功能进入工作台；用顶部搜索或 Command / Ctrl + K 查找入口。平台导览说明研究、配置与复盘之间的关系。
landing.helpBody.en-US: Open a workflow stage or shortcut. Search from the header or press Command / Ctrl + K. The tour explains how research, allocation and review connect.

landing.helpNote.zh-CN: 研究示例只说明研究方向，不是假造的运行结果。最近访问记录仅保存在当前浏览器，可单独清空；不会删除任何研究数据。
landing.helpNote.en-US: Examples describe research ideas, not fabricated results. Visits are stored only in this browser; clearing them never deletes research data.

landing.workspaceBody.zh-CN: K 是界面标识，不代表已登录账户。首页不创建身份、账户或交易，也不会触发数据下载或指标计算。
landing.workspaceBody.en-US: K is a visual identifier, not an authenticated account. The homepage creates no identity, accounts or trades and starts no downloads or calculations.

landing.workspaceNote.zh-CN: 语言沿用系统语言设置；最近打开只记录访问过的功能模块，不保存产品编号、查询条件或研究内容。
landing.workspaceNote.en-US: Language follows the application settings. Recent visits store only module identifiers, never product IDs, query parameters or research content.

landing.exampleNotice.zh-CN: 此内容为研究方向示例，不是已完成的研究结果，也不是投资建议。
landing.exampleNotice.en-US: This is a research idea, not a completed result or investment recommendation.

landing.example.regime.zh-CN: 沪深 300 历史情景识别

landing.exampleBody.regime.zh-CN: 可在情景算法工作台选择实际可用的指数研究序列，定义市场状态并校验历史区间。打开入口不会自动选择数据或计算。
landing.exampleBody.regime.en-US: Choose an available index series in the scenario workbench, define market states and validate historical periods. Opening it does not select data or run calculations.

landing.exampleBody.evaluation.zh-CN: 可在产品评价与分类工作台选择真实产品和版本化指标方案，开展比较与评价。示例未预先创建模型或评价结果。
landing.exampleBody.evaluation.en-US: Choose real products and a versioned indicator plan in the evaluation workspace. This example creates no model or evaluation result.

landing.exampleBody.allocation.zh-CN: 可从战略资产配置入口建立大类资产，研究目标权重、风险预算与回测表现。研究方案与真实组合持仓严格区分。
landing.exampleBody.allocation.en-US: Build asset classes and explore weights, risk budgets and backtests. Research proposals remain distinct from actual portfolio holdings.

landing.tour.0.title.zh-CN: 先理解产品，再形成判断。
landing.tour.0.title.en-US: Understand the product. Form a view.

landing.tour.0.body.zh-CN: 从产品研究与评价出发，沉淀可复用的产品池。数据、指标和情景算法为每个研究问题提供共同基础。
landing.tour.0.body.en-US: Start with product research and evaluation. Build reusable product pools supported by shared data, indicators and scenario algorithms.

landing.tour.1.title.en-US: Put allocation hypotheses to the test.

landing.tour.1.body.zh-CN: 围绕投资目标组织 SAA、TAA 与产品配置研究，再进行回测和风险检查。研究方案不等于真实持仓。
landing.tour.1.body.en-US: Explore strategic, tactical and within-class allocation. Validate with backtests and risk checks. A research proposal is not an actual holding.

landing.tour.2.body.zh-CN: 组合中心登记真实组合，衔接投中、基金会计与投后，最后把结论反馈给研究。部分环节为静态功能演示，以工作台提示为准。
landing.tour.2.body.en-US: The portfolio center registers actual portfolios and connects execution, accounting and review. Feed conclusions back into research. Some stages are static demonstrations, as marked in their workspaces.

rollingScope.intro.zh-CN: 选择一个区间指标，设置窗口，系统每天对最近一段数据重新计算。
rollingScope.intro.en-US: Choose an interval metric and a window. Recalculate the entire metric at each date.

rollingScope.summary.zh-CN: 对最近 {{window}} 个{{unit}}逐日计算“{{name}}”。
rollingScope.summary.en-US: Calculate {{name}} over the latest {{window}} {{unit}} at each date.

rollingScope.invalidWindow.zh-CN: 请输入 1 至 5000 的整数窗口。
rollingScope.invalidWindow.en-US: Enter an integer window from 1 to 5000.

rollingScope.ruleText.zh-CN: 每个窗口独立执行完整计算图。默认要求完整有效窗口；已设置最少有效观察数的指标按其计算图处理缺失，不补零、不改变日期位置、不读取未来数据。
rollingScope.ruleText.en-US: Recompute the interval graph in each window. Complete valid windows are required by default; explicit minimum-count definitions handle missing data in their graph, without filling, date compression or future data.

rollingScope.parameters.zh-CN: 生成后可在“计算参数”中开放窗口调整；在其他页面修改只影响本次计算。
rollingScope.parameters.en-US: After generation, expose the window in Calculation parameters. Overrides affect only the current run.

rollingScope.supported.zh-CN: 支持滚动计算 · 每个窗口独立重算完整指标
rollingScope.supported.en-US: Rolling supported: recompute the entire metric in each window

rollingScope.unknown.zh-CN: 尚未确认区间聚合能力，请先保存并校验指标。
rollingScope.unknown.en-US: Interval capability is not confirmed. Save and validate the metric first.

rollingScope.graphHint.zh-CN: 滚动计算连接的是可执行的区间计算图，不是已算好的全样本标量；上游计算内容会在每个窗口内重新运行。
rollingScope.graphHint.en-US: A rolling node receives an executable interval graph, not a precomputed full-sample value. Its body runs independently inside each window.

outputAuthoring.locked.zh-CN: 请等待当前操作完成，并应用画布改动后再编辑结果。
outputAuthoring.locked.en-US: Finish the current operation and apply graph changes before editing outputs.

indicatorParameters.editorHint.zh-CN: 先完成公式或应用画布，再识别可调输入。未开放的输入保持固定；同值常量不会自动合并。
indicatorParameters.editorHint.en-US: Complete the formula or apply the canvas, then inspect eligible inputs. Unopened inputs stay fixed; equal constants are not automatically linked.

indicatorParameters.showUsage.zh-CN: 查看公式中的使用位置

indicatorParameters.noCandidates.zh-CN: 没有其他可开放的输入。数据输入和公式结构常量保持固定。
indicatorParameters.noCandidates.en-US: No other eligible inputs. Data inputs and structural constants stay fixed.

indicatorParameters.confirmFix.zh-CN: 将“{{name}}”的全部引用固定为默认值？保存指标后生效，历史版本不变。
indicatorParameters.confirmFix.en-US: Fix all references to “{{name}}” at its default? This takes effect after saving; historical revisions stay unchanged.

indicatorParameters.pending.zh-CN: 参数设置尚未应用，请先应用再校验或保存指标。
indicatorParameters.pending.en-US: Apply these parameter settings before validating or saving the indicator.

indicatorParameters.definitionError.zh-CN: 请填写名称及合法数值；默认值必须在范围内并符合类型、步长，步长必须大于 0。
indicatorParameters.definitionError.en-US: Enter a name and valid values. The default must match the range, type and step; step must be positive.

indicatorParameters.requestError.zh-CN: 参数操作失败，请检查公式后重试。
indicatorParameters.requestError.en-US: Parameter operation failed. Check the formula and retry.

indicatorParameters.applyCanvasFirst.zh-CN: 请先完成当前操作并应用画布，再设置参数。
indicatorParameters.applyCanvasFirst.en-US: Complete the current operation and apply the canvas before editing parameters.

indicatorParameters.runtimeHint.zh-CN: 调整参数只影响本次查看，不会改动指标定义。
indicatorParameters.runtimeHint.en-US: Adjusting parameters affects this view only; the saved indicator is unchanged.

indicatorParameters.unapplied.zh-CN: 参数已修改，点击“应用参数”后重算。
indicatorParameters.unapplied.en-US: Parameters edited. Choose Apply parameters to recalculate.

indicatorParameters.error.required.zh-CN: 请输入参数值，不能留空。
indicatorParameters.error.required.en-US: Enter a value; this field cannot be empty.

indicatorParameters.error.integer.en-US: This parameter must be an integer.

indicatorParameters.error.range.en-US: The value is outside the allowed range.

indicatorParameters.error.step.zh-CN: 请从最小值起按指定步长取值。
indicatorParameters.error.step.en-US: Use the specified step starting at the minimum.

indicatorParameters.parameterNode.zh-CN: 可变参数：{{code}}。默认值和范围在计算参数面板设置。
indicatorParameters.parameterNode.en-US: Adjustable parameter: {{code}}. Edit its default and range in Calculation parameters.

indicatorParameters.connectionError.zh-CN: 可变参数只能连接系统允许的算子参数位置。
indicatorParameters.connectionError.en-US: Adjustable parameters can connect only to eligible operator inputs.

indicatorParameters.fixedHint.zh-CN: 此版本未开放可变参数，按固定公式计算。
indicatorParameters.fixedHint.en-US: This revision has no adjustable parameters and uses its fixed formula.

i18n.matrix.finishCell.zh-CN: 正在编辑单元格：按 Enter 确认或 Esc 取消后，再保存或切换页面。
i18n.matrix.finishCell.en-US: Editing a cell: press Enter to commit or Esc to cancel before saving or changing views.

i18n.matrix.batchLimit.zh-CN: 单次最多修改 1000 个单元格，请先保存当前修改。此次粘贴未应用。
i18n.matrix.batchLimit.en-US: Edit up to 1,000 cells per batch. Save the current changes first. This paste was not applied.

i18n.matrix.hint.zh-CN: 第一列是稳定代码，每列是一种语言。双击或按 Enter 编辑；方向键移动，Shift＋点击选择区域，可粘贴 Excel 矩形区域。修改后统一保存。
i18n.matrix.hint.en-US: Stable codes stay in the first column. Double-click or press Enter to edit. Use arrows to navigate, Shift+click to select, and paste rectangular Excel ranges. Save changes together.

i18n.matrix.readOnlyHint.zh-CN: 系统语言包只读；缺少内置译文时明确显示回退内容，不把回退值记为已翻译。
i18n.matrix.readOnlyHint.en-US: System language packs are read-only. Missing translations show a fallback preview, not a completed translation.

i18n.matrix.editHint.zh-CN: Enter 确认，Shift＋Enter 换行，Esc 取消本次编辑。清空译文恢复默认。
i18n.matrix.editHint.en-US: Enter commits, Shift+Enter inserts a line, Esc cancels this edit. Clear text to restore the default.

i18n.matrix.pasteInvalid.zh-CN: 粘贴区域无效或超过当前页/语言列范围，未应用任何修改。请只复制译文区域，不要包含表头或系统代码。
i18n.matrix.pasteInvalid.en-US: Invalid paste or range exceeds this page/language columns. Nothing changed. Copy translation cells only, without headers or system codes.

i18n.matrix.invalidCell.zh-CN: 译文超长、含不允许内容或占位符不匹配；未应用修改。
i18n.matrix.invalidCell.en-US: Translation is too long, contains disallowed content or has mismatched placeholders. No changes applied.

i18n.matrix.languagesSaved.zh-CN: 语言列已保存，现有译文和计算定义不变。
i18n.matrix.languagesSaved.en-US: Language columns saved. Existing translations and calculations are unchanged.

i18n.matrix.languageExample.en-US: For example ja-JP, fr-FR or zh-Hant-TW

i18n.matrix.addHint.zh-CN: 新增的是业务译文列，不会自动翻译。没有系统语言包时，菜单使用所选内置回退语言。语言代码保存后不可改名或删除，可停用并保留译文。
i18n.matrix.addHint.en-US: A new business translation column is not automatic translation. Menus use the selected built-in fallback when no system pack exists. Saved codes cannot be renamed or deleted; disable to retain translations.

i18n.matrix.languageInvalid.zh-CN: 请填写有效且不重复的语言代码和名称。最多 24 种语言。
i18n.matrix.languageInvalid.en-US: Enter a valid unique language code and name. Up to 24 languages.

i18n.matrix.saveFirst.zh-CN: 请先保存或取消译文草稿，再修改语言列。
i18n.matrix.saveFirst.en-US: Save or discard translation drafts before managing language columns.

i18n.matrix.pendingOutside.zh-CN: 其他分类或页面中仍有未保存的译文。
i18n.matrix.pendingOutside.en-US: Other categories or pages contain unsaved translations.

errors.I18N_DUPLICATE_LOCALE.en-US: This language code is already registered.

errors.I18N_BUILTIN_LOCALE_LOCKED.zh-CN: 内置语言不能修改或停用。
errors.I18N_BUILTIN_LOCALE_LOCKED.en-US: Built-in languages cannot be changed or disabled.

errors.I18N_DEFAULT_LOCALE_DISABLED.zh-CN: 请先更换工作区默认语言，再停用该语言。
errors.I18N_DEFAULT_LOCALE_DISABLED.en-US: Change the workspace default before disabling this language.

errors.I18N_LOCALE_UNKNOWN.zh-CN: 请先添加对应语言列，再填写或导入译文。
errors.I18N_LOCALE_UNKNOWN.en-US: Add the language column before editing or importing translations.

errors.I18N_LOCALE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN.zh-CN: 语言不能删除，可停用并保留译文。
errors.I18N_LOCALE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN.en-US: Languages cannot be deleted. Disable them to retain translations.

i18n.refreshReview.zh-CN: 已刷新当前译文，未保存修改已保留。请检查修改预览后再保存。
i18n.refreshReview.en-US: Translations refreshed. Your unsaved changes are preserved. Review the preview before saving.

navigation.directoryHint.zh-CN: 选择一个流程节点进入对应工作区。已有能力直接复用，静态演示节点使用预置示例数据呈现未来功能与交互边界。
navigation.directoryHint.en-US: Choose a workflow step to open its workspace. Available features are operational; prototype steps illustrate planned functionality using sample data.

graph.restoreHint.zh-CN: 不会用旧公式覆盖当前输入。可返回高级公式模式修复，或重新构建。
graph.restoreHint.en-US: Your current input will not be replaced by an older formula. Fix it in the formula editor, or start again.

graph.messages.changed.zh-CN: 画布已修改。检查并应用后，才能保存或预览新计算。
graph.messages.changed.en-US: Graph changed. Check and apply it before saving or previewing the new calculation.

graph.messages.restoring.zh-CN: 正在从当前公式还原画布…
graph.messages.restoring.en-US: Restoring the graph from the current formula…

graph.messages.restoreFailed.zh-CN: 当前公式暂不能还原。可以返回公式模式修复，或从空白画布重新构建。
graph.messages.restoreFailed.en-US: This formula cannot be restored as a graph. Fix it in the formula editor or start with an empty graph.

graph.messages.ready.zh-CN: 从左到右：输入数据 → 计算步骤 → 最终输出。点击任一步骤即可修改。
graph.messages.ready.en-US: Read left to right: inputs → calculation steps → final outputs. Click any step to edit it.

graph.messages.incomplete.zh-CN: 请先补全标记的输入与输出。
graph.messages.incomplete.en-US: Complete the marked inputs and outputs first.

graph.messages.invalid.zh-CN: 画布未通过检查。点击问题可定位需要修改的步骤。
graph.messages.invalid.en-US: Graph validation failed. Select an issue to locate the affected step.

graph.messages.applied.zh-CN: 画布已应用到指标草稿。保存指标或前往“校验与预览”运行真实计算。
graph.messages.applied.en-US: Graph applied to the indicator draft. Save the indicator or open Validation and preview to calculate.

graph.messages.valid.zh-CN: 结构与类型检查通过；尚未编译或执行数值计算。
graph.messages.valid.en-US: Structure and types are valid. No numerical compilation or calculation has been performed.

graph.messages.layoutSaved.zh-CN: 画布布局已保存，指标版本和计算结果不变。
graph.messages.layoutSaved.en-US: Layout saved. The indicator revision and calculation results are unchanged.

graph.messages.blank.zh-CN: 空白画布：先添加数据和算子，再连接到最终输出。
graph.messages.blank.en-US: Empty graph: add data and operators, then connect the final output.

graph.selectInput.en-US: Choose an upstream step or constant

graph.outputIdentifierHint.zh-CN: 字母或下划线开头，可含数字；用于区分输出通道。
graph.outputIdentifierHint.en-US: Start with a letter or underscore; digits are allowed. Identifies the output channel.

graph.outputIdentifierError.zh-CN: 通道标识不能重复，只能使用字母、数字或下划线，且不能以数字开头。
graph.outputIdentifierError.en-US: Use a unique channel identifier containing letters, digits and underscores; it must not start with a digit.

graph.outputPlacementHint.zh-CN: 图表位置由使用指标的研究页面决定，此处只定义计算和数值展示。
graph.outputPlacementHint.en-US: The research page decides where charts appear. This editor defines calculations and number presentation only.

graph.selectStep.zh-CN: 点击画布中的步骤或输出，查看输入、设置常量及选择上游。
graph.selectStep.en-US: Select a step or output to inspect inputs, configure constants and choose upstream steps.

graph.sharedHint.zh-CN: 这个步骤被 {{count}} 处引用。修改会影响所有下游；只改一条分支时，请复制步骤后重新连接。
graph.sharedHint.en-US: This step has {{count}} references. Editing affects all consumers. Duplicate and reconnect it to change only one branch.

graph.booleanHint.zh-CN: 判断值（选中为“是”，未选中为“否”）

graph.deleteHint.zh-CN: 删除会断开下游输入，可通过“撤销”恢复。
graph.deleteHint.en-US: Deleting disconnects downstream inputs. Undo restores them.

graph.constantHint.zh-CN: 固定数值写入指标版本，不随运行条件变化。
graph.constantHint.en-US: The constant is fixed in the indicator revision and does not vary with execution context.

graph.saveDefinitionFirst.zh-CN: 计算已修改，请先保存指标。
graph.saveDefinitionFirst.en-US: The calculation changed. Save the indicator first.

graph.layoutOnly.zh-CN: 只保存布局，不增加指标版本。
graph.layoutOnly.en-US: Save layout only, without creating an indicator revision.

graph.defaultInstructions.zh-CN: 点击节点编辑参数；拖动端口连接依赖。
graph.defaultInstructions.en-US: Click a node to edit its parameters; drag ports to connect dependencies.

graph.emptyHint.zh-CN: 从节点库添加节点，或载入一个可修改的流程。
graph.emptyHint.en-US: Add nodes from the library or load an editable workflow.

graph.constantSync.zh-CN: 这里修改的是相连的常量节点，画布与参数同步更新。
graph.constantSync.en-US: This edits the connected constant node. The graph and parameter update together.

graph.sharedConstant.zh-CN: 此常量被 {{count}} 处引用，修改会同步影响这些输入。
graph.sharedConstant.en-US: This constant is referenced {{count}} times; editing it changes all those inputs.

navigation.viewAll.en-US: View all steps in this stage

i18n.description.zh-CN: 系统语言包只读；业务术语可以自定义。显示名称变化不会修改公式、内部标识或计算结果。
i18n.description.en-US: System language packs are read-only. Business terminology can be customized without changing formulas, identifiers or results.

i18n.browserHint.zh-CN: 只影响当前浏览器，不改变币种、时区、计算精度或其他人的语言偏好。
i18n.browserHint.en-US: Affects this browser only, not currency, time zone, calculation precision or another user's preference.

i18n.defaultHint.zh-CN: 影响尚未单独设置语言的浏览器。业务翻译在当前工作区共享；本系统尚无独立的翻译管理员角色。
i18n.defaultHint.en-US: Applies to browsers without a language preference. Business translations are shared in this workspace; there is no separate translation administrator role.

i18n.defaultSaved.zh-CN: 工作区默认语言已保存。

graph.noteHint.zh-CN: 可选，说明这一步做什么

primitiveAuthoring.singleHint.zh-CN: 一个指标对应一个结果。分别选择多个指标时，系统自动复用相同的计算步骤。

riskScales.descriptionText.en-US: View, edit and maintain configured C1–C5 risk scales.

riskScales.reloadDraft.zh-CN: 重新加载草稿（放弃未保存修改）

riskScales.problem.DRAFT_SCHEMA_UNSUPPOR.zh-CN: 草稿结构不兼容或损坏。请返回列表新建研究，原草稿未被改写。
riskScales.problem.DRAFT_SCHEMA_UNSUPPOR.en-US: This draft has an unsupported or damaged structure. Return to the list to start a new study. The original draft was not changed.

riskScales.problem.REFERENCE_HASH_MISMAT.zh-CN: 所选冻结版本的身份或内容校验不一致，请重新选择。
riskScales.problem.REFERENCE_HASH_MISMAT.en-US: The selected frozen reference does not match its identity or content hash. Select the reference again.

riskScales.horizontalTableHint.zh-CN: 表格可左右滑动，查看各档授权上限与参考收益。
riskScales.horizontalTableHint.en-US: Scroll the table sideways to view each risk cap and reference return.

riskScales.requestError.en-US: The request could not be completed.

riskScales.networkError.zh-CN: 请检查服务连接并重试。
riskScales.networkError.en-US: Check the service connection and retry.

riskScales.conflict.zh-CN: 内容或版本已变化，请重新加载并核对后继续。
riskScales.conflict.en-US: Inputs or versions have changed. Reload and review before continuing.

riskScales.nameForDraft.zh-CN: 填写名称后可保存草稿。
riskScales.nameForDraft.en-US: Enter a name to save a draft.

riskScales.purposeHint.zh-CN: 可选。用于补充说明这套风险标尺适用于什么场景。
riskScales.purposeHint.en-US: Optional. Add context about where this risk scale is intended to be used.

riskScales.totalReturnVolatility.zh-CN: 总收益口径的年化波动率

riskScales.priceReturnVolatility.zh-CN: 价格口径的年化波动率

riskScales.draftSaved.zh-CN: 已保存修订 {{revision}}；未发布标尺。
riskScales.draftSaved.en-US: Revision {{revision}} saved. The scale has not been published.

riskScales.existingCmaHint.zh-CN: 直接引用冻结假设与资产轴，不重复录入或重新拟合。币种及口径不匹配的版本不可选。
riskScales.existingCmaHint.en-US: Use frozen assumptions and asset order without re-entry or refitting. Incompatible currency or basis is unavailable.

riskScales.datesInvalid.zh-CN: 研究日不能在未来，复核日须在研究日之后。
riskScales.datesInvalid.en-US: The research date cannot be in the future. Review must be due after it.

riskScales.horizonInvalid.zh-CN: 预测期限须为 1–30 年的整数。
riskScales.horizonInvalid.en-US: The forecast horizon must be an integer from 1 to 30 years.

riskScales.boundsInvalid.zh-CN: 上下限须为 0%–100% 的有限数值，且下限不能高于上限。
riskScales.boundsInvalid.en-US: Bounds must be finite values from 0% to 100%, with lower no greater than upper.

riskScales.capsInvalid.zh-CN: 请填写五个非负、严格递增的有限风险上限；空白不代表零。
riskScales.capsInvalid.en-US: Enter five finite, non-negative and strictly increasing caps. Blank does not mean zero.

riskScales.rationaleRequired.zh-CN: 请填写至少 5 个字符的人工阈值依据。
riskScales.rationaleRequired.en-US: Provide a manual threshold rationale of at least 5 characters.

riskScales.referenceDatesRequired.zh-CN: 填写参考名称和完整样本区间，开始日须早于截止日，截止日不得晚于研究日。
riskScales.referenceDatesRequired.en-US: Enter a reference name and full sample window, with start before end and end no later than the research date.

riskScales.assetsRequired.zh-CN: 请至少添加一个大类，并填写每个大类的名称。
riskScales.assetsRequired.en-US: Add at least one asset class and give each asset a name.

riskScales.cashCountInvalid.zh-CN: 一套风险标尺最多定义一个纯现金大类。
riskScales.cashCountInvalid.en-US: A risk scale can contain at most one pure cash asset.

riskScales.cashAssetInvalid.zh-CN: 现金只允许填写年化收益率，不能带代理或再平衡规则。
riskScales.cashAssetInvalid.en-US: Cash only accepts an annual return and cannot have proxies or a rebalancing rule.

riskScales.marketAssetInvalid.zh-CN: 请为非现金大类选择至少一个代理，并保留有效的再平衡规则。
riskScales.marketAssetInvalid.en-US: Select at least one proxy for each non-cash asset and keep a valid rebalancing rule.

riskScales.weightsInvalid.zh-CN: 非现金代理权重须为有限非负数并明确合计 100%；不会自动归一化。
riskScales.weightsInvalid.en-US: Non-cash proxy weights must be finite, non-negative and explicitly total 100%. They are never automatically normalized.

riskScales.confirmUpstreamRequired.zh-CN: 核对来源、警告与保存范围后，请勾选明确确认。
riskScales.confirmUpstreamRequired.en-US: Review sources, warnings and what will be saved, then explicitly confirm.

riskScales.notReady.zh-CN: 计算服务尚未就绪，请稍后重新加载。
riskScales.notReady.en-US: The calculation service is not ready. Reload when ready.

riskScales.confirmPublishRequired.zh-CN: 请确认全部警告及本次不可变发布内容。
riskScales.confirmPublishRequired.en-US: Acknowledge all warnings and confirm this immutable publication.

riskScales.previewUpdating.zh-CN: 分档设置已变化，正在自动更新结果…
riskScales.previewUpdating.en-US: Segmentation changed. Updating the result automatically…

riskScales.previewPending.zh-CN: 请完成有效的分档边界输入，系统会自动更新结果。
riskScales.previewPending.en-US: Complete valid segmentation boundaries and the result will update automatically.

riskScales.confirmReference.zh-CN: 确认保存参考资产与代理

riskScales.upstreamReview.zh-CN: 核对将保存的参考版本
riskScales.upstreamReview.en-US: Review the reference version to save

riskScales.confirmReferenceText.zh-CN: 我已核对来源与警告，确认保存参考资产、代理和收益面板；此操作不发布风险标尺。
riskScales.confirmReferenceText.en-US: I reviewed the sources and warnings and confirm saving reference assets, proxies and the return panel. This does not publish a risk scale.

riskScales.confirmPublishText.zh-CN: 我已核对当前内容，确认发布该版本。设为系统默认将在发布后另行确认。
riskScales.confirmPublishText.en-US: I reviewed the current content and confirm publishing this version. Setting it as the system default requires a separate confirmation.

riskScales.sourceLimits.zh-CN: 指数直接使用用户选择的指数值；ETF／基金使用复权价格或复权净值。代理不受市场、币种或产品池限制；样本区间自动取所有非现金代理的共同历史交集。
riskScales.sourceLimits.en-US: Indices use the selected index level directly. ETFs/funds use adjusted price or adjusted NAV. Proxy selection is not gated by market, currency or product pool; the sample window is the strict common historical intersection across non-cash proxies.

riskScales.noSourcesHint.zh-CN: 尝试其他名称、代码或来源类型；也可先在数据中心准备合格数据，再重试。
riskScales.noSourcesHint.en-US: Try another name, code or source type, or prepare qualified data in the data center and retry.

riskScales.unsupportedSource.zh-CN: 来源、字段或数据覆盖尚不支持
riskScales.unsupportedSource.en-US: Source, field or coverage is not supported

riskScales.templateHint.zh-CN: 模板仅提供现金、利率债、信用债、权益和黄金的分类起点，不包含虚构收益或已发布默认。
riskScales.templateHint.en-US: The template starts with cash, rates, credit, equity and gold. It contains no invented returns or published default.

riskScales.referenceBasis.zh-CN: 当前独立输入：CNY、SSE、日频，年化 252；费用按来源内含口径，不另计费，不隐式换汇。
riskScales.referenceBasis.en-US: Standalone inputs: CNY, SSE, daily, annualization 252; source-embedded fees, no extra fee or implicit currency conversion.

riskScales.cashReferenceRate.zh-CN: 参考：中国银行非定期存款挂牌利率 0.05%（仅供参考，不自动带入）。
riskScales.cashReferenceRate.en-US: Reference: Bank of China non-term deposit listed rate 0.05% (reference only; not applied automatically).

riskScales.cashHint.zh-CN: 现金只能填写年化收益率，不能选择代理或再平衡；默认收益率 0%，波动率及与其他资产协方差固定为 0。
riskScales.cashHint.en-US: Cash only accepts an annual return and cannot use proxies or rebalancing. Its return defaults to 0%; volatility and covariance with other assets are fixed at zero.

riskScales.marketHint.zh-CN: 非现金大类选择指数、ETF 或基金代理生成参考收益；默认每日按目标权重计算加权收益率。
riskScales.marketHint.en-US: Non-cash assets use index, ETF or fund proxies to build reference returns; by default the target weights are restored daily.

riskScales.rebalance.daily.zh-CN: 默认。每个有值日按目标权重计算当日加权收益率。
riskScales.rebalance.daily.en-US: Default. Restore target weights on every valued date before calculating the next daily return.

riskScales.rebalance.monthly.zh-CN: 在每月最后一个共同有值日期收盘后恢复目标权重，其余时间随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.monthly.en-US: Restore target weights after the last common valued date of each month; weights drift between resets.

riskScales.rebalance.quarterly.zh-CN: 在每季最后一个共同有值日期收盘后恢复目标权重，其余时间随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.quarterly.en-US: Restore target weights after the last common valued date of each quarter; weights drift between resets.

riskScales.rebalance.yearly.zh-CN: 在每年最后一个共同有值日期收盘后恢复目标权重，其余时间随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.yearly.en-US: Restore target weights after the last common valued date of each year; weights drift between resets.

riskScales.rebalance.buy_and_hold.zh-CN: 初始按目标权重配置后不再平衡，权重随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.buy_and_hold.en-US: Allocate at target weights initially, then never rebalance; weights drift with prices.

riskScales.cashFixedCma.zh-CN: 现金收益率 {{value}}；波动率、均值不确定性及与其它资产协方差固定为 0。
riskScales.cashFixedCma.en-US: Cash return {{value}}; volatility, mean uncertainty and covariance with other assets are fixed at zero.

riskScales.cashCorrelationFixed.zh-CN: 当前没有需要填写的非现金相关系数；现金相关项固定为 0。
riskScales.cashCorrelationFixed.en-US: There are no non-cash correlations to enter. Cash correlations are fixed at zero.

riskScales.manualSourceRequired.zh-CN: 人工假设必须说明来源或依据，至少 3 个字符。
riskScales.manualSourceRequired.en-US: Manual assumptions require a source or rationale of at least 3 characters.

riskScales.historicalSourceOptional.zh-CN: 可选。历史统计的结构化来源、样本区间和版本已由系统保存。
riskScales.historicalSourceOptional.en-US: Optional. Historical statistics already retain structured source, sample-window and version evidence.

riskScales.historicalHint.zh-CN: 样本均值作为本次参考预期；计算由共享后端完成，不保证未来收益。
riskScales.historicalHint.en-US: The sample mean is used as the reference expectation, calculated by the shared backend. It does not guarantee future returns.

riskScales.manualHint.zh-CN: 填写人工收益、波动和完整相关矩阵；缺失项不填零，不修复或替代输入。
riskScales.manualHint.en-US: Enter manual returns, volatility and a complete correlation matrix. Missing inputs are not filled with zero, repaired or substituted.

riskScales.correlationHint.zh-CN: 相关系数 -1 至 1；对称项同步，主对角为 1。
riskScales.correlationHint.en-US: Correlation from -1 to 1. Symmetric entries stay aligned; diagonal entries equal 1.

riskScales.constraintHint.zh-CN: 默认不设置单大类或分组约束；无做空、无杠杆，权重合计 100%。需要限制时再展开配置。
riskScales.constraintHint.en-US: Asset and group bounds are unconstrained by default. No shorting or leverage; weights total 100%. Expand only when limits are needed.

riskScales.groupConstraintsHint.zh-CN: 分组约束与大类边界共同生效，由后端统一核验可行性。
riskScales.groupConstraintsHint.en-US: Group and asset bounds apply together. The backend checks feasibility.

riskScales.methodHint.frontier_shape_dp_.zh-CN: 按弧长加权的局部方向变化寻找连续分段；不是二阶微分曲率，也不代表客观投资偏好。
riskScales.methodHint.frontier_shape_dp_.en-US: Find contiguous segments using arc-length-weighted local directions. This is not differential curvature or an objective investor preference.

riskScales.methodHint.equal_volatility_v.zh-CN: 在有效前沿的风险跨度内寻找等距分界，再匹配有序有效节点。
riskScales.methodHint.equal_volatility_v.en-US: Find equal risk intervals across the efficient frontier, then match ordered valid nodes.

riskScales.methodHint.equal_arclength_v1.zh-CN: 按标准化风险收益曲线的累计弧长分段。
riskScales.methodHint.equal_arclength_v1.en-US: Segment by cumulative arc length of the normalized risk-return curve.

riskScales.methodHint.equal_return_v1.zh-CN: 按有效前沿最低到最高的预期年收益跨度等分五段，并将各收益分界点对应的波动率作为风险等级边界。
riskScales.methodHint.equal_return_v1.en-US: Split the efficient-frontier expected-return span into five equal ranges, then use the volatility at each return cut as the risk-level boundary.

riskScales.methodHint.manual_volatility_.zh-CN: 明确填写五个上限及依据；超出参考前沿的区间保持未校准。
riskScales.methodHint.manual_volatility_.en-US: Specify five caps and a rationale. Intervals beyond the reference frontier remain uncalibrated.

riskScales.unsupportedMethod.en-US: This algorithm is not currently executable

riskScales.manualCapsHint.zh-CN: 首项可为零，五项必须严格递增。没有有效代表点的档位不会生成收益或权重。
riskScales.manualCapsHint.en-US: The first cap may be zero; all five must strictly increase. Empty bands have no invented returns or weights.

riskScales.manualSeedRationale.zh-CN: 基于当前算法边界人工调整
riskScales.manualSeedRationale.en-US: Manual adjustment based on current algorithm boundaries

riskScales.boundaryAdjustmentHint.zh-CN: 算法先给出初始边界；可精确微调 C1–C5 上限。边界采用前开后闭，修改后代表组合、预期收益、波动率和画像会自动重算。
riskScales.boundaryAdjustmentHint.en-US: The algorithm supplies initial boundaries. Fine-tune the C1–C5 caps precisely. Bands are open-left/closed-right; representative portfolios, expected return, volatility and portraits update automatically.

riskScales.reuseFrontier.zh-CN: 切换分档算法或人工阈值只重新分档，复用同一条已计算的有效前沿，不重复读取历史数据。
riskScales.reuseFrontier.en-US: Changing the segmentation algorithm or manual caps only re-segments the same computed efficient frontier without reloading historical data.

riskScales.comparisonHint.zh-CN: 各方法使用同一输入和前沿。对比结果不会改变当前选定方法，发布只采用一种。
riskScales.comparisonHint.en-US: Methods use the same inputs and frontier. Comparison does not change the selected method; publication uses exactly one.

riskScales.notPublishable.zh-CN: 尚未满足发布条件，请处理下列问题。
riskScales.notPublishable.en-US: Publication requirements are not met. Resolve the issues below.

riskScales.chartDescription.zh-CN: 目标收益网格的最小方差有效前沿；完整数值可从下方表格读取。
riskScales.chartDescription.en-US: Minimum variance frontier over a target-return grid. The table below provides the values.

riskScales.noFrontier.zh-CN: 没有通过核验的前沿点

riskScales.noFrontierHint.zh-CN: 检查来源和约束后重试；未成功的目标不会通过插值补齐。
riskScales.noFrontierHint.en-US: Check sources and bounds, then retry. Failed targets are not interpolated.

riskScales.capMeaning.zh-CN: C3 表示最高允许风险，不要求组合达到 C3 的下界。边界相等归入较低档。
riskScales.capMeaning.en-US: C3 is a maximum allowance, not a minimum risk band. Equality belongs to the lower level.

riskScales.representativeMeaning.zh-CN: 收益、ES 和回撤属于参考代表组合，不是整档的收益或损失承诺；缺失指标不等于零。
riskScales.representativeMeaning.en-US: Return, ES and drawdown describe a representative portfolio, not a promise for the entire band. Missing metrics are not zero.

riskScales.tableHelp.zh-CN: 选择任一等级可高亮代表组合，展开详情可读权重与指标。
riskScales.tableHelp.en-US: Select a level to highlight its representative. Expand details for weights and metrics.

riskScales.fallback.zh-CN: 算法已记录退化原因：{{reason}}。未将其隐瞒为用户主动选择。
riskScales.fallback.en-US: The algorithm recorded a fallback reason: {{reason}}. This is distinct from an explicit method selection.

riskScales.noRepresentative.zh-CN: 该档没有有效代表组合，收益、权重及画像不可用。
riskScales.noRepresentative.en-US: This band has no valid representative. Return, weights and portraits are unavailable.

riskScales.noConfiguredHint.zh-CN: 点击“新建标尺”开始配置 C1–C5 风险等级。
riskScales.noConfiguredHint.en-US: Select New Risk Scale to configure C1–C5 risk levels.

riskScales.deletePublishedConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除“{{name}}”？该版本将不再出现在可用列表中，但历史审计仍保留。
riskScales.deletePublishedConfirm.en-US: Delete {{name}}? It will leave the available list, while historical audit records remain.

riskScales.deleteDraftConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除草稿“{{name}}”？草稿删除后不可恢复。
riskScales.deleteDraftConfirm.en-US: Delete draft {{name}}? Draft deletion cannot be undone.

riskScales.deleteReason.zh-CN: 用户从风险等级配置中心删除该配置
riskScales.deleteReason.en-US: Deleted from the risk scale configuration center

riskScales.researchDayFromPit.zh-CN: 参考研究日自动使用当前 PIT 日期：{{date}}
riskScales.researchDayFromPit.en-US: The reference research date automatically uses the current PIT date: {{date}}

riskScales.researchDayFromToday.zh-CN: 当前未选择 PIT 日期，参考研究日自动使用今天：{{date}}
riskScales.researchDayFromToday.en-US: No PIT date is selected. The reference research date automatically uses today: {{date}}

riskScales.researchDayPending.zh-CN: 正在读取当前 PIT 口径，确认前不能开始风险标尺计算。
riskScales.researchDayPending.en-US: Loading the current PIT context. Risk-scale calculation stays disabled until it is resolved.

riskScales.researchDatePitHint.zh-CN: 由当前 PIT 日期自动生成，不可手工修改。
riskScales.researchDatePitHint.en-US: Automatically generated from the current PIT date and cannot be edited manually.

riskScales.researchDateTodayHint.zh-CN: 当前无 PIT 日期，因此自动使用今天；不可手工修改。
riskScales.researchDateTodayHint.en-US: No PIT date is active, so today is used automatically and cannot be edited manually.

riskScales.reviewDateOptionalHint.zh-CN: 可选。提前 30 天提示临近复核，到期后继续提醒；不会自动让标尺失效。
riskScales.reviewDateOptionalHint.en-US: Optional. A reminder appears 30 days before review and remains after the due date; it does not expire the scale automatically.

riskScales.referencePreviewTitle.zh-CN: 核对历史数据与共同区间
riskScales.referencePreviewTitle.en-US: Review historical data and common window

riskScales.intersectionMeaning.zh-CN: 系统按所有非现金代理实际可用日期取严格交集；现金不会缩短该区间。
riskScales.intersectionMeaning.en-US: The system uses the strict intersection of actual available dates across all non-cash proxies; cash does not shorten the window.

riskScales.referenceRequired.zh-CN: 请先核对并冻结参考资产历史数据。
riskScales.referenceRequired.en-US: Review and freeze the reference-asset history first.

riskScales.marketAssetRequired.zh-CN: 至少需要一个非现金大类用于构建有效前沿。
riskScales.marketAssetRequired.en-US: At least one non-cash asset is required to build the efficient frontier.

riskScales.coveragePending.zh-CN: 覆盖区间将在读取后核验
riskScales.coveragePending.en-US: Coverage will be verified after loading

riskScales.reviewReminder.zh-CN: 预计复核日：{{date}}。该提醒不影响标尺继续使用。
riskScales.reviewReminder.en-US: Review due date: {{date}}. This reminder does not stop the scale from being used.

riskScales.selectVersion.zh-CN: 选择 {{name}} v{{version}} 进行比较

riskScales.noSchemesHint.zh-CN: 调整筛选，或使用新建标尺完成参考输入、校准和发布。
riskScales.noSchemesHint.en-US: Adjust filters, or create a scale to complete reference inputs, calibration and publication.

riskScales.noDrafts.zh-CN: 暂无已保存草稿；新建后可显式保存。
riskScales.noDrafts.en-US: No drafts saved yet. Create a scale and save it explicitly.

riskScales.includeRetired.zh-CN: 显示已停用的历史版本

riskScales.exactlyTwo.zh-CN: 请选择恰好两个不同的版本。

riskScales.copyInputs.en-US: Copy inputs to a new study

riskScales.readonlyHint.zh-CN: 本页读取发布时冻结的结果，不会重新拟合或计算。
riskScales.readonlyHint.en-US: This page reads the exact frozen publication and never refits or recomputes it.

riskScales.alreadyDefault.zh-CN: 此版本已是系统默认，无需重复切换。
riskScales.alreadyDefault.en-US: This version is already the system default.

riskScales.retiredNotice.zh-CN: 已停止新引用；历史冻结结果仍可读取。
riskScales.retiredNotice.en-US: New references are disabled. Historical frozen results remain readable.

riskScales.defaultChanged.zh-CN: 默认已更新；已有引用保持原版本。
riskScales.defaultChanged.en-US: Default updated. Existing references retain their original version.

riskScales.defaultImpact.zh-CN: 仅影响后续选择。已有目标与研究继续引用原版本，历史数值不会改写。
riskScales.defaultImpact.en-US: This affects future selections only. Existing objectives and studies retain their original version and values.

riskScales.retireReason.zh-CN: 停用依据（至少 5 个字符）

riskScales.clearDefault.zh-CN: 我明确确认同时清空当前默认，不自动选择替代版本。
riskScales.clearDefault.en-US: I explicitly confirm clearing the current default without automatically choosing a replacement.

riskScales.confirmGovernance.zh-CN: 我已核对版本及本次操作的影响。
riskScales.confirmGovernance.en-US: I reviewed the version and impact of this action.

riskScales.governanceRequired.zh-CN: 请填写必要依据并确认；停用默认版本还需明确勾选清空默认。
riskScales.governanceRequired.en-US: Provide the required reason and confirmation. Retiring the default also requires explicitly clearing it.

riskScales.compareVersions.zh-CN: 比较两个风险标尺版本

riskScales.compareFromList.zh-CN: 返回列表，勾选两个精确版本后再进入比较。
riskScales.compareFromList.en-US: Return to the list and select two exact versions.

riskScales.compatibleComparison.zh-CN: 口径兼容；以下为右侧相对左侧的后端边界差异，不作优劣排名。
riskScales.compatibleComparison.en-US: Compatible basis. Boundary differences below are calculated by the backend as right minus left, without ranking.

riskScales.incompatibleComparison.zh-CN: 币种或风险语义不兼容，仅并列阅读，不叠加曲线或比较数值差。
riskScales.incompatibleComparison.en-US: Currency or risk semantics are incompatible. Read side by side without overlaying curves or numerical differences.

riskScales.numberRequired.zh-CN: 请输入完整的有限数值；空白不代表零。
riskScales.numberRequired.en-US: Enter a complete finite number. Blank does not mean zero.

riskScales.groupsInvalid.zh-CN: 分组须有唯一名称、至少一个资产及合法上下限。
riskScales.groupsInvalid.en-US: Groups require unique names, at least one asset and valid bounds.

riskScales.dataWindow.zh-CN: 实际数据区间 {{start}} 至 {{end}}；{{observations}} 个收益观测。
riskScales.dataWindow.en-US: Actual data window {{start}} to {{end}}; {{observations}} return observations.

riskScales.stability.unstable_calibratio.zh-CN: 网格复核不稳定，请核对边界移动
riskScales.stability.unstable_calibratio.en-US: Grid validation is unstable; review boundary shifts

riskScales.stability.manual_policy_thres.zh-CN: 人工政策阈值，非自动校准稳定性结论
riskScales.stability.manual_policy_thres.en-US: Manual policy thresholds, not an automatic stability finding

riskScales.stability.manual_adjustment.zh-CN: 已基于算法结果人工微调边界
riskScales.stability.manual_adjustment.en-US: Boundaries manually fine-tuned from the algorithm result

riskScales.metricUnit.daily_es_95_decima.zh-CN: 日频，95% 经验尾部损失

riskScales.correlationInvalid.zh-CN: 相关矩阵仍有空项或超出 -1 至 1 的系数，请展开矩阵补齐。
riskScales.correlationInvalid.en-US: The correlation matrix has blank entries or values outside -1 to 1. Expand it and complete the entries.

riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_REFEREN.zh-CN: 参考资产与固定成分为事后研究，不证明历史时点可投资。
riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_REFEREN.en-US: Reference assets and fixed components are retrospective research, not proof of historical investability.

riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_INPUT_INVALI.zh-CN: 冻结风险矩或约束无法形成可验证前沿；不会修补矩阵或放宽约束。
riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_INPUT_INVALI.en-US: The frozen risk matrix or bounds cannot produce a verified frontier. Inputs will not be repaired or bounds relaxed.

riskScales.problem.RESEARCH_SCALE.zh-CN: C1–C5 是本工作区研究标尺，不是跨机构适当性评级。
riskScales.problem.RESEARCH_SCALE.en-US: C1–C5 is this workspace's research scale, not a universal suitability rating.

riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_UNVERIFIED.zh-CN: 前沿存在未验证点或求解失败，不能发布；请查看诊断。
riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_UNVERIFIED.en-US: The frontier has unverified or failed points and cannot be published. Review the diagnostics.

riskScales.problem.NEAR_LINEAR_FRONTIER.zh-CN: 形状算法检测到近直线，按其内部规则采用弧长切分。
riskScales.problem.NEAR_LINEAR_FRONTIER.en-US: The shape method detected a near-linear frontier and applied its documented arc-length fallback.

riskScales.problem.MANUAL_POLICY_THRESHO.zh-CN: 人工阈值依据由研究者提供，超出参考范围的部分未校准。
riskScales.problem.MANUAL_POLICY_THRESHO.en-US: Manual thresholds are supported by researcher evidence. Portions beyond the reference range remain uncalibrated.

riskScales.problem.BOUNDARY_ADJUSTED.zh-CN: 分档边界已在算法结果上人工微调；代表组合和相关指标已按调整后的区间重新计算。
riskScales.problem.BOUNDARY_ADJUSTED.en-US: Boundaries were manually fine-tuned from the algorithm result. Representative portfolios and related metrics were recalculated for the adjusted bands.

riskScales.problem.UNSTABLE_CALIBRATION.zh-CN: 101/200 点复核未稳定，请核对差异后再采用。
riskScales.problem.UNSTABLE_CALIBRATION.en-US: The 101 / 200 point check is unstable. Review differences before adopting the result.

riskScales.problem.ENDPOINT_MISMATCH.zh-CN: 两次前沿端点不一致，无法完成稳定性验证。
riskScales.problem.ENDPOINT_MISMATCH.en-US: The two frontier endpoint sets differ; stability validation cannot be completed.

riskScales.problem.STABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 200 点分档验证失败，当前自动标尺不能发布。
riskScales.problem.STABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: The 200-point segmentation check failed. This automatic scale cannot be published.

riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_PORTRAI.zh-CN: 代表组合按各代理配置的再平衡规则回放，仅是事后画像；ES 为日频经验值，不是年度损失保证。
riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_PORTRAI.en-US: Representative replay follows each proxy's configured rebalancing rule and is retrospective only. ES is a daily empirical metric, not an annual loss guarantee.

riskScales.problem.VERSION_RETIRED.zh-CN: 版本已退休，仅供历史读取。
riskScales.problem.VERSION_RETIRED.en-US: The version is retired and available for historical reading only.

riskScales.problem.VERSION_EXPIRED.en-US: The version has passed its hard expiry date.

riskScales.problem.REVIEW_DUE.zh-CN: 版本已到复核日，请建立复核后的新版本。
riskScales.problem.REVIEW_DUE.en-US: The review date has arrived. Create a newly reviewed version.

riskScales.problem.FROZEN_REFERENCE_UNAV.zh-CN: 冻结参考来源不可读、失效或校验失败。
riskScales.problem.FROZEN_REFERENCE_UNAV.en-US: A frozen reference is unreadable, expired or failed validation.

riskScales.problem.DEFAULT_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 默认版本不可读或已不具备引用资格。
riskScales.problem.DEFAULT_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: The default version is unreadable or no longer eligible for new references.
